scope.gdpr: European regulation on the protection of personal data; applies to anyone who processes the data of people in the EU.
scope.hipaa: Administrative, physical and technical safeguards to protect electronic health information in the US.
scope.iso27001: International certification of an information security management system, with 93 controls in Annex A.
scope.nist_csf: Voluntary cybersecurity framework organized into six functions: govern, identify, protect, detect, respond and recover.
scope.pci_dss: Payment card industry standard to protect cardholder data, with 12 requirements.
scope.soc1: Attestation report on the controls of a service organization that affect its clients' financial reporting.
scope.soc2: Attestation report on the controls of a service organization relevant to security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality and privacy, according to the AICPA Trust Services Criteria.
